commentary: Graded the walks' eight resolved entries over their sweep scopes at 237e5622. I re-read each edit site and checked the two code claims the walks leaned on. `review-system` declares `before: archive` (schemas/spec-driven/schema.yaml:205), so the system gate is always the frontier. `canonicalNextForReviewed` already tests `unresolvedPass` after `openPair` and before every slot command (gates.ts:1122), so step (2) of the new order extends an existing step rather than adding one. Seven entries landed cleanly. The one regression is the widest edit, Sal's A: it rewrote the order's owner correctly but left three places still describing the narrower rule. Those are a predicted-map count, a table heading and scenario in the requirement it qualified, and the exploration's Mechanism row. All three are wording that an implementer reading the delta whole would resolve the right way. The residual diff lists five files; four are inside the edit records, and the fifth is the fingerprint stamp.
